username.format: Username must be 3–16 characters long and can only contain letters (A–Z, a–z), numbers (0–9), underscores (_), or hyphens (-).
username.unavailable: Username is already taken by another account

email.format: Email must be a valid email address
email.unavailable: Email is already used by another account

password.length: Password must be at least 8 characters long
password.uppercase: Password must contain at least one uppercase letter (A–Z)
password.lowercase: Password must contain at least one lowercase letter (a–z)
password.digit: Password must contain at least one digit (0–9)
password.special: Password must contain at least one special character (e.g., !@#$%^&*)

firstname.length: First name must be between 2 and 27 characters long
firstname.format: First name can only contain letters and spaces

lastname.length: Last name must be between 2 and 27 characters long
lastname.format: Last name can only contain letters and spaces

birthday.format: Birthday must be in the format dd.MM.yyyy (e.g., 06.11.2022)
birthday.range: Birthday must be realistic (not in the future or more than 100 years ago)
birthday.young: You must be at least 13 years old to register
